sample_unit: paired responses (GPT-4 and GPT-4o) rated by three physicians

links.outcome: Validity of references cited in ChatGPT answers about radioactive iodine therapy
links.effect: Fully valid references were present in 20.6% of GPT-4 and 21.4% of GPT-4o responses.
links.quote: Citation accuracy was limited: fully valid references were present in 20.6% of GPT-4 and 21.4% of GPT-4o responses.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to make model reasoning transparent for qualitative evaluation

screen.reason: The study evaluates GPT-4 and GPT-4o's performance on patient education questions regarding radioiodine therapy using chain-of-thought prompting, but does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
